OpenBallance needs your own copy of Ballance: a disc image (`.iso`), the CD, or an installed game. No game
data is included.

- **macOS**: unzip and open `Ballance (gasm).app` (ad-hoc signed: the first time, right-click → Open).
- **Linux**: unpack and run `./openballance.sh` (`--install-desktop` adds a menu entry).
- **Windows**: unzip and run `OpenBallance.cmd`.
- **Any system**: `gasm-run openballance-<version>.wasm --rom Ballance.iso` with gasm 0.6.0 or newer.

Or play in the browser: https://openballance.emdzej.pl/play/
